ops.title: Trailing-window branch waits on the cc-transcript tail_bytes/tail_events release
ops.body: Branch fix/transcript-tail-reader @ cbf48981 (pushed, no PR): hook clients send tail_bytes=4 MiB on acquire/warm_root/warm_registered/prepare_graph; hooks declare transcript_events=N and a dispatch sends the widest as tail_events on acquire; per-dispatch source-byte cap deleted; each skipped hook named once per session (worker/fail_open.py). Cannot ship before cc-transcript accepts tail_bytes/tail_events: vendored request schemas set additionalProperties false on acquire. Next: bump the cc-transcript pin, refresh captain_hook/snapshots/schemas and internal/snapshots/schema, run tests/test_foreground_evidence_budgets.py::test_a_transcript_past_the_window_reads_only_its_tail against the real engine, open the PR, merge, release, brew upgrade + package-install. Engine contract: engine-spec.md sent to cc-transcript-incremental-classifier (task #87). Findings: note ec14737.
